_comment: Single source of truth for the daily-options-trader skill. Edit this file to change behavior. Set enabled=false to pause all autonomous trading without deleting the schedule.

instrument_scope.notes: Single-leg long calls only. No puts, no spreads, no covered calls, no cash-secured puts, no equities, no crypto.

universe.description: Highly liquid, optionable large-cap US equities. Re-validated for tradability each run via get_equity_tradability; never assumed static.

strike_selection.notes: If the option chain response exposes delta, prefer picking the strike closest to delta ~0.35 instead and use %OTM only as a fallback/sanity check.

rules: RSI(14) between 50 and 70 (momentum without being overbought)
signal.rank_by: RSI(14) descending among names passing all three rules
signal.tie_break: narrower option bid-ask spread (% of mid) wins

exit.notes: Exit checks and executions run every day regardless of the daily halt or the new-trade cap — managing existing risk down is never blocked.

order_execution.buy_limit_rule: at the current ask; if spread > liquidity filter, use the midpoint instead and skip if still not marketable
order_execution.sell_limit_rule: at the current bid; if spread > liquidity filter, use the midpoint instead
